details: Produced Stream 3 gap analysis across 3 files: Part A (Desktop — 4-column layout, nav reduction, hover/click, level cutoff, wireframe diagram), Part B (Mobile — hybrid accordion+drill-down, 3 wireframe states, implementation specs), Part C (Hierarchy mapping table, competitor comparison, 15 key decisions, 7 unresolved items).
